general_notes: This fees structure applies to Year One (new) students for the academic year 2026-2027.
There is no change of fees (tuition and other fees) for ongoing students (Year 2, 3 and 4).
All fees are the same for both national and international students.

faqs.answer: All fees are the **same for both national and international students**. 🌍
There is **no change of fees** (tuition and other fees) for **ongoing students (Year 2, 3 and 4)**. The 2026-2027 fee structure applies to **Year One (new) students only**.

ULK has two campuses: **Kigali Campus** (P.O. Box 2280 Kigali) and **Gisenyi Campus** (Rubavu). Undergraduate tuition at Gisenyi is generally lower than at Kigali. Ask me about any programme to compare both campuses.
Undergraduate tuition is quoted **per term (3 terms per year)**. UPI programmes are quoted **per year**, Master's programmes **per module (160,000 Rwf)**, and PhD **per semester (1,500,000 Rwf)**.
